contract.maintenance: Repair/degradation arises from actual component, exposure and compatible engineering or craftsmanship profile; no universal wear cycle.
contract.instance_binding: Material descriptor is not a stock lot. An actual piece, item or bulk material needs an owned asset or stock record and measured units.
contract.overrides: A setting may define a special grade with explicit supported properties, but cannot silently rewrite existing components.
contract.runtime: Read material family as a construction/property constraint; defer numerical effects to the selected calibrated material/component profile.
contract.portability: Reusable in historical, survival, fantasy and technical contexts where this material exists, without imposing any era or fantasy physics.
